rationale.conceptual: The method (transfer matrix, Boltzmann factors, phase identification from entropy) is an established but non-trivial algorithm. The paper provides the explicit matrix for M=3, but correct implementation requires understanding of the physics (activities, eigenvalue, derivatives, entropy plateaus) and careful handling of finite-difference perturbations. It is more than a trivial textbook operation but not a novel custom method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is a straightforward sequence of steps: build matrix from given entries, compute eigenvalue and derivatives, then sweep mu to detect phases. All steps use standard scientific Python (NumPy/SciPy). No external dataset, no complex tooling or multi-stage dependencies beyond a single script. I/O is simple text and CSV.
